# 1 Enoch Chapter 36 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**1** And from there I went to the south to the ends of the earth, and I saw there three open portals of heaven; and from there come dew and rain and wind.

**2** And from there I went to the east to the ends of the heaven, and I saw there the three eastern portals of heaven open and small portals above them.

**3** Through each of these small portals pass the stars of heaven and run their course to the west on the path that is shown to them.

**4** And as often as I saw these things, I always blessed the Lord of Glory; and I continued to bless the Lord of Glory who has wrought great and glorious wonders, to show the greatness of his work to the angels and to human beings, that they might praise his work and all his creatures: that they might see the work of his power and praise the great work of his hands and bless him forever.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Ge'ez text. Chapter 36 concludes the Book of Watchers (chs. 1-36). Verses 1-3 describe the southern and eastern portals; verse 4 is Enoch's great closing doxology, blessing the Lord of Glory for revealing his cosmic works so that angels and humans alike might worship. The verse echoes the doxology of ch. 9 and anticipates the praise theology of the Parables (chs. 37-71).*
